chunks: Those in the Fire will say to the warders of Hell: 'Ask your Lord to reduce the punishment by a day for us.'
ai.seo_question: What do the people in Hell ask the keepers to do for them regarding their punishment?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse illustrates the psychological torment of the disbelievers who, despite their prior rejection of divine signs, now seek a temporary respite from the Zabaniyah. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a moment of regret where the 'day' requested is not merely a pause but a transition to a more severe, eternal state, emphasizing that divine mercy was available in the world of action but is now fixed in the world of consequence.
